definitions.explanation: An object or arrangement used to make something look more attractive.

examples.japanese: ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飾|かざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I took out the Christmas decorations.
There is a flower decoration in the room.

examples.japanese: お⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飾|かざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いに→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to buy New Year decorations.

notes:
{飾|かざ}り is a noun meaning decoration or ornament. It comes from the verb ⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to decorate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飾|かざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to put up decorations)
- {飾|かざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (to take down decorations)
- {飾|かざ}り⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (display shelf)
- {飾|かざ}り⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧ (display window)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{髪飾|かみかざ}り→髪飾り：28228_kamikazari⟧ (hair ornament)
- ⟦{首飾|くびかざ}り→首飾り：15077_kubikazari⟧ (necklace)
- ⟦{正月飾|しょうがつかざ}り→正月飾り：20983_shougatsukazari⟧ (New Year decorations)

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to decorate, to display)
